label: United States
relationships: contains all states in scope (50 states + DC)
notes: National totals cover the 50 states and DC. Puerto Rico and the Island Areas are outside U.S. totals in ACS, PEP, BEA and LAUS.

label: Census region
relationships: state -> region from catalog/geo_states.csv (verified by summing state totals)
notes: Puerto Rico and Island Areas are not in any Census region.

label: Census division
notes: Benchmark only when benchmark_levels includes division.

label: State or equivalent
notes: DC and Puerto Rico are state-equivalents; Puerto Rico has no region and is not in the U.S. total.

label: County or equivalent
relationships: exact nesting in state; intersection with places from ACS place-by-county parts (summary level 155)
notes: Includes parishes, boroughs, census areas, independent cities and (from 2022) Connecticut planning regions.

label: Census place (incorporated place or CDP)
relationships: within one state; counties intersected from ACS place-by-county parts with published population
notes: Places may cross county lines; distinct places never overlap.

label: Part of a place within one county
relationships: exact: one place and one county
notes: Used internally to resolve unions of a place with a county without double counting (ACS summary level 155).

label: County subdivision (MCD/CCD)
notes: Data via ACS; relations to places are not published by the Census API, so unions mixing county subdivisions and places are rejected.

label: Census tract
relationships: exact nesting in county; place intersections from boundary files (area only)
notes: Tract boundaries were redrawn for 2020; tract histories across the 2020 redraw are not harmonized.

label: Block group
notes: Large margins of error; intended for maps within a study area.

label: ZIP Code Tabulation Area
relationships: intersections with counties and places from the 2020 relationship files (land area)
notes: ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP Code service areas; they are not postal ZIP codes. Unions with overlapping places or counties are rejected (no published parts).

label: Metropolitan or micropolitan statistical area
relationships: union of whole counties (OMB delineation used by the ACS release)
notes: Delineations change; each ACS release uses the delineation current for its reference year.

label: Unified school district
relationships: within one state; other relations not implemented
notes: Elementary and secondary districts overlap unified districts in some states; not yet supported in unions.

label: Custom polygon
notes: Not supported in this release: statistics for arbitrary polygons need allocation from small areas, which must be explicitly enabled and labeled. Documented extension point.
